response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change.

ZORVATH
(nervously)
But, your majesty, the people love the traditional look. It's... it's... (he consults a parchment)...timeless.

KING
(dismissively)
Timeless? Ha! I want something new, something bold, something... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, your majesty? I'm not sure I understand.

KING
(exasperated)
Don't you know what vaporwave is? It's a style, a movement, a way of life. It's all about nostalgia, futurism, and a dash of surrealism. I want our kingdom to reflect that.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
I see. And how do you propose we achieve this, your majesty?

KING
(determined)
We'll start by replacing the traditional coats of arms with... (he consults a sketchbook)... pixelated, glitchy versions. And the banners will be replaced with... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...this young man's (he nods to the servant)...fashionable, neon-lit attire.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Uh, yes, your majesty.

KING
(to Zorvath)
And the architecture! We'll replace the stone walls with... (he snaps his fingers)...a mesh of twinkling, fiber-optic lights. And the moat will be filled with... (he grins mischievously)...a sea of fog, complete with... (he consults a blueprint)...a fleet of hovercraft.

ZORVATH
(stunned)
Your majesty, I think you've been spending too much time in the... (he glances around)...vaporwave.

KING
(laughing)
Ah, but that's the beauty of it, Zorvath! I'm not just a king, I'm a visionary. And I'll stop at nothing to bring this vision to life.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. He's wearing a sleek, neon-lit jumpsuit, and his hair is styled in a futuristic, asymmetrical manner.

KING
(to his courtiers)
I want this kingdom to be a beacon of... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave chic. I want the people to be inspired by our... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...fashionable, avant-garde aesthetic.

COURTIER 1 (she)
Your majesty, but what about the traditional values of our kingdom? The chivalry, the honor, the... (she consults a parchment)...the feudal system?

KING
(dismissively)
Pfft, those are just old-fashioned notions. We're a kingdom of the future, my friends. And the future is... (he grins)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The stone walls are now a mesh of twinkling, fiber-optic lights, and the moat is filled with a sea of fog. The knights are wearing neon-lit armor, and the merchants are hawking their wares in a futuristic, glitchy manner.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Behold, my friends! Our kingdom is now a true... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave utopia.

COURTIER 2 (he)
Your majesty, it's... it's... (he consults a parchment)... quite something.

KING
(laughing)
I told you, my friends. I'm a visionary. And this is just the beginning.

FADE TO BLACK.
